summary.intent: Work through pending todos in the cipher-box project, starting with wiring CTR encryption for media uploads in the SDK, then debugging BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging, and finally fixing a release gate workflow that failed to detect successful desktop E2E runs.
summary.outcome: Completed three todos: (1) wired CTR encryption for media uploads through the SDK with centralized encryption-mode module; (2) added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (the root cause of 400/403 errors) and fixed load test ipns-publish to use proper signed records; (3) fixed release gate to search standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs in addition to ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs. Also fixed 9 API test files with broken mock typing patterns, regenerated api-client, and excluded Rust target/ from ESLint.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed in the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts but was never called by the SDK's uploadFile() — new uploads always used GCM regardless of file type/size
setByoStatus() was a dead service method in the API — the vault controller had no endpoint to toggle BYO mode, meaning the BYO pipeline could never be enabled via the API

The release gate workflow (release-gate.yml) only searches ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs for desktop E2E results, but successful desktop tests run as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs — they were never found
The ci-e2e.yml orchestrator skips desktop jobs when no desktop changes are detected per-commit; standalone desktop-e2e.yml runs are triggered separately
All SDK test files that mocked @cipherbox/sdk-core used bare factory pattern (replacing entire module), which drops any new exports and causes CI failures on every new export added to sdk-core
The load test workload's ipns-publish call was sending {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record, metadataCid} — it was fundamentally wrong and would always 400
The Rust build artifacts in target/ were not excluded from ESLint, causing 261 of 262 lint errors to come from generated Rust doc/debug JS files
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from the STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set in both the SDK client and the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts
pnpm api:generate requires the API server to be running to generate the OpenAPI spec via ts-node scripts/generate-openapi.ts
The .husky/commit-msg file is modified locally by the Entire CLI tool — should be in .git/info/exclude to prevent it appearing in git diffs

code.finding: encryptAesGcm was hardcoded; encryptionMode param was not accepted — CTR path never activated for new uploads
uploadFile did not call selectEncryptionMode() before passing to sdkCore.uploadFile — mode selection only happened on re-encrypt path
New centralized module with STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode() — imported by both SDK client and web app
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added; setByoStatus() was previously orphaned service method with no controller route
Old code immediately broke on first failed run in SHA range without checking if desktop tests actually executed — shadowed older successful standalone runs
createByoClientPool never called PATCH /vault/byo-status — test accounts were never in BYO mode, causing all register-cid calls to return 403
ipns-publish step sent {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires signed IPNS record via {ipnsName, record, metadataCid}; createSdkContext was also recreated per loop iteration
Mock of @cipherbox/sdk-core used bare factory — adding selectEncryptionMode to sdk-core caused CI failure; fixed to use importOriginal + spread pattern

workflow: When adding exports to a shared package, all test files that mock that package with bare factory pattern will break in CI — audit all vi.mock() calls using the same pattern proactively

After adding API endpoints, run pnpm api:generate against a running server to regenerate api-client; only committing specific files can leave new model files untracked, causing CI drift checks to fail
The correct mock pattern for vitest is: vi.mock('pkg', async (importOriginal) => { const actual = await importOriginal(); return { ...actual, mockedFn: vi.fn() }; }) to survive new exports
When investigating 400 errors on an API endpoint, check both DTO validation failures AND authorization guards (403) — the actual error can be different from what's reported in load test summaries
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot both post review threads automatically; resolve them promptly as they accumulate across review rounds

friction: The release gate bug required multiple iterations to fully understand — initial fix (stop-at-first-failed-run) was correct but incomplete; root cause was different workflow files (ci-e2e.yml vs desktop-e2e.yml) not being searched together
pnpm api:generate runs ESLint as part of the pipeline and lint:fix failed due to Rust target/ files — obscured whether generation succeeded; had to parse output carefully
Orval generation created new model files in packages/api-client/src/ that weren't staged in the commit, causing a CI drift check failure requiring a follow-up commit
Pre-existing TypeScript errors across 9+ API spec files required significant cleanup before the new vault controller code could pass typecheck — systemic jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern issue
The .husky/commit-msg file kept appearing in git diffs due to Entire CLI local modifications — required adding to .git/info/exclude
GraphQL API calls to GitHub timed out in some polling attempts; had to fall back to REST API for review thread fetching
An accidental apps/api/openapi.json file (3889 lines) was created during manual spec generation and committed — had to be removed in a follow-up commit
